en: A black-and-white photograph of an industrial harbor showing a cargo ship named 'FORTUNA' moored alongside a quay. The vessel, marked with the number '676' on its bow, sits in calm water. Behind it stand several large lattice cranes and long, low warehouse buildings with gabled roofs, and a skeletal steel frame of another structure. The scene has a mid‑20th‑century industrial feel, with no visible tourists or decorative elements, just working dock facilities and workers on the ship.
